mappings.assertion: TestS1SizeGuard fails if the await_resubmission.go file key or the awaitResubmissionWithOptions or reclaimForReview key is still in area_a5_test.go's ratchet while the code is over the limit, and fails if any remaining key grows. All three keys are removed. awaitResubmissionWithOptions is an orchestrator over enterAwaitResubmission (argument, agent, last-rejector, halt, escalation and status preconditions), resubmissionEntry.reclaimEarly, resubmissionEntry.acquireReservation and awaitedResubmission.run (watcher loop, with observe shared by the abort check, the watcher and the polling fallback poll). reclaimForReview is reclaimTransaction: snapshotCandidate, apply (admit, checkBoundary, assign) and project. await_resubmission.go keeps entry, preconditions, the waiting loops and the status classification, review_reservation.go the reservation acquire, hold, release and finish, review_reclaim.go the reclaim transaction, each file under the limit.

TestOracleA5Supplement compares the json, human and state captures of RW1-RW4 (PAUSED at entry; the reclaim refused by the review-boundary check when the review commit is not the worktree HEAD, when the base commit is not the effective review base, and when the review base cannot be resolved, which routes the task to INTEGRATION_FAILED) and the state and result captures of RW5 (TERMINAL when the task leaves the waiting set while the reservation is held) and RW6 (PAUSED while the reservation is held) against goldens committed in 7f37ae104 before any production edit, generated by regen write-new on the unchanged tree. The delivered AR1-AR3 cover RESUBMITTED, the escalated abort and the wrong-reviewer refusal; POLL and TIMEOUT depend on elapsed time and stay with the white-box await tests. TestSupplementGoldenCoverage pins coverage; regen -mode check -pkg ./internal/oracle/a5/... reproduces every golden.

The await-resubmission white-box tests (await_resubmission_test.go, await_resubmission_reservation_test.go, await_resubmission_lifecycle_test.go, await_pause_test.go, await_policy_test.go, assignment_preflight_test.go, generation_fence_lifecycle_test.go) keep every assertion, changed only by string(...) conversions of the typed constants, and run under the race detector against the split awaitResubmissionWithOptions and reclaimForReview; they pin the watcher and polling fallback, abort and pause handling, reservation loss, evidence-refusal cleanup, the reclaim's preflight and ownership revalidation and ownership release. TestRetainedReservationRequiresTheAgentsLiveHold pins the extracted retained-reservation rule.

TestAwaitResubmissionVocabularyKeepsItsValues compares each AwaitResubmissionOutcome constant with the literal it replaced, TestAwaitResubmissionResultKeepsStringFields pins that AwaitResubmissionResult.Verdict stays a JSON string reached by conversion, and TestReviewLeaseDurationsKeepTheirValues pins reclaimReviewLeaseDuration at 30 minutes and reviewOwnershipLeaseMargin at 5 minutes. The reclaim validation refusals use the delivered validationCode constants, the lifecycle error uses LifecycleSafeActionRequery and LifecycleEffectsNone, and the work-admission operation labels are named constants with unchanged values; the test-replaceable newAwaitResubmissionWatcher stays a variable.

TestOracleA5 compares the delivered A5 goldens live, including AR1's <lease:+30m> reclaim lease; none changes (git diff of internal/oracle/a5/testdata/golden against the starting commit is empty), and no older supplement golden changes.
TestS1SizeGuard enforces that area_a5_test.go ratchet keys only shrink: the three K-AWT await-resubmission keys are gone and no key was added or raised.
test target (go test ./...) runs the ops, archguard and A5 oracle suites including the new tests; lint, test-e2e and the race run are mandatory with it.
